metadata.name: GetEligiblityDetailsForBT
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to get Available BT Amount, Promotion BT details and Full rate BT plans on the account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Example: 7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Condition:  At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Example: 12345

request_fields.name: RequestedBTAmount
request_fields.description: Requested Balance Transfer Amount. Default value is 0.00 (Zero Dollars) Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1000.00

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AvailableBTAmount
children.description: Available Balance Transfer Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 1000.00

children.name: TransactionFeeAmount
children.description: Transaction Fee Amount ($). Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.00

children.name: TotalTransactionAmount
children.description: Sum of requested BT amount and Transaction Fees. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00

children.name: HoldBusinessDays
children.description: Hold period for BT Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10

children.name: EligibleForBT
children.description: This flag will decide if balance transfer is allowed or not as per account status. Valid Values: 0 = Not Eligible for Balance Transfer,1 = Eligible for Balance Transfer Example: 0

children.name: AccountStatus
children.description: Status of the Account. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: Active Allowable Values: 100

children.name: HoldDaysDisclosure
children.description: Disclosure based on hold days. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Balance Transfers is usually processed in 2-4 business days. However, for new  accounts it may take up to 16 business days. Allowable Values: 2000

children.name: EligiblePromoBTPlans
children.description: List of Eligible promotional offer on account

children.name: BTPromoId
children.description: ID of Promo plan Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 123

children.name: BTPromoName
children.description: Name of Promo plan Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Promotional  BT Plan 1 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: APR
children.description: APR of Standard plan Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: 1.00%

children.name: TransactionFees
children.description: Transaction Fees in percent (%) Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 3.00%

children.name: OfferCode
children.description: Offer code of promo plan Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345

children.name: PromoRateDuration
children.description: Duration of Promo rate in month Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 6

children.name: DetailedDisclosure
children.description: Product wise detailed disclosure. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Allowable Values: 2000

children.name: FullRateBTPlans
children.description: List of standard plan on account

children.name: FullRateBTPlanID
children.description: ID of full rate BT plan Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 123

children.name: FullRateBTPlanName
children.description: Name of full rate BT plan Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: Ignite Full Rate BT Plan 1 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: APR
children.description: APR of full rate BT plan Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Example: 1.00%

children.name: TransactionFees
children.description: Transaction Fees in percent (%) Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 3.00%

children.name: OfferCode
children.description: Offer code of promo plan Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: DetailedDisclosure
children.description: Product wise detailed disclosure. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Allowable Values: 2000
